title: MILITARY WELFARE FUND ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to contribute to stable livelihoods of military personnel, etc. and enhancement of the combat capabilities of the armed forces by establishing and operating the Military Welfare Fund for efficient implementation of welfare projects for the military.

Article 2 (Definitions) The terms used in this Act are defined as follows:
1. "Welfare facilities" means welfare facilities under subparagraph 3 of Article 2 of the Framework Act on Military Welfare;
2. "Sports facilities" means sports facilities under subparagraph 4 of Article 2 of the Framework Act on Military Welfare.

Article 3 (Establishment of Military Welfare Fund) The Government shall establish the Military Welfare Fund to achieve the purpose referred to in Article 1.

Article 3-2 (Accounts of Military Welfare Fund) The Military Welfare Fund shall be divided into a welfare account, an educational-loan account, and a housing-support account. <Amended on December 24, 2018>

Article 4 (Financial Resources and Uses of Welfare Account)
(1) The welfare account shall consist of the following financial resources: <Amended on March 27, 2015>
1. Revenue generated from operation of welfare facilities and sports facilities (hereinafter referred to as "welfare facilities, etc.");
2. User fees paid by persons other than the State who are permitted to use welfare facilities, etc.;
3. Revenue generated from projects to increase the Military Welfare Fund;
4. Proceeds from sale of property of the Military Welfare Fund;
5. Transfers from other accounts or funds;
6. Borrowings from other accounts or funds;
7. Deposits received from other accounts of the Military Welfare Fund;
8. Operating income of the welfare account.
(2) The welfare account shall be operated for the following purposes: <Amended on March 27, 2015>
1. Maintenance and management of welfare facilities, etc.;
2. Establishment and expansion of welfare facilities, etc.;
3. Projects prescribed by Presidential Decree as necessary for boosting morale of military personnel, civilian military employees, and their families;
4. Support for scholarship projects for children of military personnel and civilian military employees;
5. Support for military research activities by reserve military personnel;
6. Repayment of principal and interest on borrowings;
7. Other expenses necessary for adjustment, management, or operation of the welfare account.

Article 4-2 (Financial Resources and Uses of Educational-Loan Account)
(1) The educational-loan account shall consist of the following financial resources:
1. Transfers from other accounts or funds;
2. Borrowings from other accounts or funds;
3. Deposits received from other accounts of the Military Welfare Fund;
4. Operating income of the educational-loan account.
(2) The educational-loan account shall be operated for loans of educational expenses for military personnel themselves and their children.

Article 4-3 (Financial Resources and Uses of Housing-Support Account)
(1) The housing-support account shall consist of the following financial resources: <Amended on March 27, 2015; December 24, 2018>
1. The following revenue related to housing support under Article 9 (1) of the Framework Act on Military Welfare:
  (a) Occupancy deposits collected to secure obligations arising from housing support;
  (b) Delayed-vacating charges collected where a person required to vacate official housing fails to do so;
  (c) Principal and interest repaid, including interest for delayed repayment, on private-housing rental funds supported under Article 9 (1) 2 of the Framework Act on Military Welfare;
  (d) Amounts recovered where private-housing rental funds under Article 9 (1) 2 of the Framework Act on Military Welfare were improperly provided;
2. Deleted <March 27, 2015>;
3. Transfers from other accounts or funds;
4. Borrowings from other accounts or funds;
5. Deposits received from other accounts of the Military Welfare Fund;
6. Operating income of the housing-support account.
(2) The housing-support account shall be operated for the following purposes: <Amended on March 27, 2015; December 24, 2018>
1. Support for private-housing rental funds under Article 9 (1) 2 of the Framework Act on Military Welfare;
2. Refund of occupancy deposits.

Article 5 (Borrowings)
(1) Where necessary to secure financial resources for the Military Welfare Fund, the Minister of National Defense may borrow, including temporary borrowing, from other accounts or funds at the expense of the Military Welfare Fund.
(2) Temporary borrowings under paragraph (1) shall be repaid within the relevant fiscal year.

Article 6 Deleted <May 24, 2011>

Article 7 (Management and Operation of Military Welfare Fund)
(1) The Military Welfare Fund shall be managed and operated by the Minister of National Defense.
(2) The accounting of the Military Welfare Fund shall be handled in accordance with the National Accounting Act.

Article 8 (Fiscal Year) The fiscal year of the Military Welfare Fund shall coincide with the fiscal year of the Government.

Article 9 (Accounting Officials of Military Welfare Fund)
(1) The Minister of National Defense shall appoint, from among public officials under his or her jurisdiction, a fund revenue collection officer, fund financial officer, fund disbursement officer, and fund cashier to perform affairs concerning revenue and expenditure of the Military Welfare Fund.
(2) The appointments under paragraph (1) may be made by designating positions established in agencies under the jurisdiction of the Minister of National Defense.

Article 10 (Establishment of Military Welfare Fund Account) The Minister of National Defense shall establish a Military Welfare Fund account with the Bank of Korea under the Bank of Korea Act.

Article 11 (Delegation of Authority) The Minister of National Defense may delegate part of the affairs concerning management and operation of the Military Welfare Fund under this Act to the Chiefs of Staff of each armed service and commanders of units directly under the Ministry of National Defense, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

ADDENDA <Act No. 5062, December 29, 1995>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on July 1, 1996.
Article 2 (Vesting of Fund) Assets and liabilities acquired or incurred through operation of welfare facilities of each unit and institution at the time this Act enters into force shall vest in the Fund, and the amount so vested shall be based on book value.
Article 3 (Transfer from Other Fund) Of the Military Pension Fund under the Military Pension Special Account Act, funds for loan projects for military personnel and related claims and liabilities existing as of June 30, 1996 shall be comprehensively succeeded to by the Fund as of July 1, 1996.
Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Operation of Welfare Facilities) Acts concerning revenue, expenditure, etc. conducted by each unit and institution in connection with operation of welfare facilities from January 1, 1996 until this Act enters into force shall be deemed acts of operation of the Fund under this Act.
Article 5 (Amendment of Other Acts)
(1) The Framework Act on Fund Management shall be amended as follows:
In the attached Table, subparagraph 117 shall be newly inserted as follows:
117. Military Welfare Fund Act
(2) The Military Pension Special Account Act shall be amended as follows:
Subparagraph 3 of Article 7 (2) shall be deleted.

ADDENDA (National Treasury Funds Management Act) <Act No. 6836, December 30, 2002>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on January 1, 2003.
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendment of Other Acts) (1) through (15) Omitted.
(16) The Military Welfare Fund Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 9 (1) and (2), "fund disbursement ordering officer and fund cashier" shall each be replaced with "fund revenue collection officer, fund financial officer, fund disbursement officer, and fund cashier," and paragraph (3) of the same Article shall be deleted.
(17) through (31) Omitted.
Article 7 Omitted.

ADDENDA <Act No. 10702, May 24, 2011>
(1) (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.
(2) (Applicability) Delayed-vacating management charges already collected at the time this Act enters into force shall become financial resources of the lease-deposit loan account of the Military Welfare Fund under amended Article 4-3.

ADDENDA <Act No. 13241, March 27, 2015>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Applicability to Occupancy Deposits as Financial Resources of Lease-Deposit Loan Account) Occupancy deposits already collected at the time this Act enters into force shall become financial resources of the lease-deposit loan account of the Military Welfare Fund under amended Article 4-3.

ADDENDA <Act No. 16032, December 24, 2018>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Housing-Support Account) Assets, claims, liabilities, and other rights and obligations of the former lease-deposit loan account at the time this Act enters into force shall be succeeded to by the housing-support account under this Act.
